# Grafana Cloud

Skills that teach agents to work with Grafana Cloud. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [grafana/ai-marketplace](https://github.com/grafana/ai-marketplace), at commit `6c28ba1`.

Hosted MCP server for AI-assisted Grafana Cloud observability — no local installation required.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Grafana Cloud**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Grafana Cloud**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install grafana-cloud-mcp@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `grafana-cloud-mcp-tools`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/grafana/ai-marketplace
